subject.title: Fallback turns can re-execute work already reported as completed (semantic recursive task execution)

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92011 as a scoped embedded-runtime mitigation while this issue remains open for gateway loopback, scheduling, and Codex-native follow-up surfaces?
rationale: Current evidence shows the bug remains on main and a proof-positive open PR covers only one mechanical surface, so automation cannot choose the permanent cross-harness policy boundary.

options.title: Accept scoped mitigation
options.body: Land the embedded sessions_spawn guard and keep this issue open for the remaining work-spawning surfaces.

options.title: Wait for common policy seam
options.body: Hold the linked PR until the fallback completion-announcement invariant can be enforced across all OpenClaw work-delegating tools in one design.

options.title: Redirect Codex-native scope upstream
options.body: Merge OpenClaw-owned guard work separately and track spawn_agent behavior in the Codex repository or owning integration.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped mitigation
recommendation.body: Land the embedded sessions_spawn guard and keep this issue open for the remaining work-spawning surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the cross-harness review that defined the remaining scope question on the linked PR.
